pages.title: Giant Warthog
pages.text: The giant warthog ($(o)Metridiochoerus$()) is an extinct genus of pig that lived in Africa during the Pliocene and Pleistocene.$(br2)As its name suggests, it was a much larger relative of the living warthogs, with some species several times their size.$(br2)Like modern warthogs, it had high-crowned teeth suited to grazing on tough grasses, and long, upward-curving tusks.
